verses.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

segments.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

notes: 148.1 Praise ye the LORD. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc

verses.text: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

segments.text: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

verses.text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

segments.text: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

verses.text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

segments.text: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that
be
above the heavens.

verses.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

segments.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.text: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

segments.text: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.text: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

segments.text: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

verses.text: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

segments.text: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.text: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

segments.text: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.text: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

segments.text: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

verses.text: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

segments.text: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.text: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

segments.text: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

verses.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

segments.text: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory
is
above the earth and heaven.

verses.text: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.

segments.text: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints;
even
of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
